{{Quote|The Mystics haven't spoken.|Yana-Ton|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Yana-Ton''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was the sister of [[Phi-Ton]] and a daughter of [[Bas-Ton]] and resided in her father's tea house in the [[Judicial Quarter]] of the [[Voss-Ka]] city. At some point prior to [[3640 BBY]] Bas-Ton was killed and replaced with an [[Bas-Ton (imposter)|impostor]] by the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Neither of his children, nor even his brother [[Therod-Ton]] ever suspected anything. Around 3640 BBY, another [[Imperial Agent]], [[Cipher Nine]], made several visits to the teahouse and pretended to become friends with the family. In reality, Cipher required contact and assistance from the Bas-Ton's impostor in their joint mission to track the [[Albathius|Shining Man]]. Bas-Ton's impostor was later killed by Cipher's old enemies and Yana-Ton grieved at the loss, never knowing her father's true fate.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yana-Ton can be romanced by and married to Cipher Nine if male and playing light side.<ref name="TOR" />
